doctrine.thesis: This work demonstrates harmonic backpropagation: coherence-driven adaptation using wave propagation, resonance retuning, and stability envelopes instead of conventional binary-only optimization.
doctrine.harmonic_pipeline: INPUT WAVE → BUBBLE LATTICE → WAVE PROPAGATION → OUTPUT WAVE → HARMONIC ERROR COMPUTATION → RESONANCE RETUNING (Δf, Δφ, Δk) → FROBENIUS STABILITY ENVELOPE → EQUILIBRIUM

commercialization.lead_message: LumenCore is a unified harmonic intelligence architecture for identity encoding, system optimization, and multimodal infrastructure intelligence.
